name: Geode Gobbler's Gobble Saloon
tagline: Crystal poker with critters in yer belly
goal: Satisfy as many of Gobbo's cravings as you can in 15 minutes.
scoring: Every Snack, Meal and Indigestion behind you (beaten or skipped) pays 100, 150 or 250 × its ante. Each Indigestion you beat adds 1 point per 2 seconds left on the clock. Plus 100 per power of ten in your best hand (a 10,000 hand = 400).

modifiers.name: High Society
modifiers.text: No cards below 10: the deck is two of every 10, J, Q, K and A (40 cards).

modifiers.name: Wild Wild West
modifiers.text: Every card is Wild (counts as every suit). The suit-hating Indigestions stay home.

modifiers.name: Glass Saloon
modifiers.text: Every card is Brittle: ×2 Shine when it scores, with a 1 in 4 chance to shatter.

modifiers.name: Flat Broke
modifiers.text: Start with $0 and never earn a cent of interest.

modifiers.name: Tall Tales
modifiers.text: Every craving is 3× bigger, but you get +3 hands every round.

modifiers.name: One Shot
modifiers.text: 1 hand per round. +4 discards and +3 hand size to line it up.

modifiers.name: Big Mitts
modifiers.text: +3 hand size: more cards to build with every hand.

modifiers.name: Butterfingers
modifiers.text: -2 hand size, and +2 discards to dig with.

modifiers.name: Critter Giveaway
modifiers.text: Every critter in the shop is free, but the shop has only 1 slot.

modifiers.name: Two's Company
modifiers.text: Only hands with a Pair in them score. Pairs start at level 3.

modifiers.name: Royal Treatment
modifiers.text: Face cards (J, Q, K) trigger twice when they score.

modifiers.name: Compost Heap
modifiers.text: Discarded cards are eaten for good (your deck shrinks). +2 discards.

modifiers.name: Boss Rush
modifiers.text: Every Snack and Meal is skipped for you (you keep the tags). Only Indigestions get played.

modifiers.name: Living Legend
modifiers.text: Start with a random Legendary critter.
